generation_prompt_constraints: Create two non-strawman shared-layout baselines with the same whole-process, preparation, correctness, compatibility, and falsifier accounting as specialized candidates; make no measured performance claim.

candidates.name: Resident Shared Projection Baseline

generation_lineage.intended_changed_behavior: Provide a strong Neo4j/GDS-like fully resident shared-projection comparison point rather than a lower-RAM proposal.

target_workload_contract.artifact: one fully resident shared property-graph projection with forward and reverse adjacency plus projected properties
target_workload_contract.algorithm_semantics: Reference-equivalent semantics for each admitted algorithm with its own state and oracle contract
target_workload_contract.a007_decision_strengthened: Provides the resident fast-path and explicit refusal baseline when full projection plus algorithm state cannot fit

genome.topology_layout: Shared resident dual adjacency with dense local IDs and resident projected properties
genome.ordering_and_identifier_representation: Dense local IDs with stable external-ID mapping and deterministic optional adjacency ordering
genome.algorithm_state_placement: All topology and current algorithm state resident in process memory
genome.scheduling_and_concurrency: Parallel workers over partitions with admitted worker and concurrent-query counts
genome.overflow_behavior: Lower concurrency, select reference engine, or refuse; no hidden spill in the baseline
genome.exactness: Per-algorithm exactness, tolerance, seed, and convergence contract
genome.admission_model: Admit only if the projection, chosen algorithm state, output, runtime, page-cache policy, and reserve fit B_user
genome.receipt_model: Emit predicted and observed projection, state, worker, output, runtime, and reserve high-water terms
genome.compatibility_boundary: Neo4j-facing procedures can be mapped, but internal store/layout and the full GDS catalog are not implicitly compatible

minimum_resident_kernel.admission_unit: complete selected projection plus one algorithm's minimum state and runtime reserve
minimum_resident_kernel.expression: RAM_kernel = RAM_dual_adjacency + RAM_projected_properties + RAM_algorithm_minimum + RAM_runtime + RAM_safety_margin

resource_model.peak_ram_equation: RAM_peak = RAM_topology + RAM_algorithm_state + RAM_frontier_active_set + RAM_scratch + RAM_output + RAM_conversion + RAM_page_cache_or_direct_io + RAM_runtime_overhead + RAM_spill + RAM_safety_margin + RAM_temporary_artifact_coexistence

ram_terms.topology: RAM_topology = c_node * N + c_edge_fwd * M + c_edge_rev * M + sum_p(c_property_p * entries_p)
ram_terms.runtime_overhead: RAM_runtime_overhead = c_runtime + c_allocator * allocation_classes + c_thread * threads
ram_terms.temporary_artifact_coexistence: RAM_temporary_artifact_coexistence = max(RAM_old_projection + RAM_new_projection, RAM_single_projection) during replacement

resource_model.preprocessing: T_prepare = T_project_nodes + T_project_edges + T_project_properties + T_order_optional + T_verify
resource_model.concurrency: RAM_concurrency = Q * RAM_algorithm_query + W * RAM_worker_private + D_io * RAM_io_buffer

state_multiplicity.stages: max_stage(RAM_stage_i) unless stage barriers permit explicit reclamation

page_cache_direct_io_policy.guard: Resident projection bytes and source page-cache bytes are distinct and both counted

preparation_model.build_peak_ram: RAM_build_peak = max(RAM_scan, RAM_id_map, RAM_adjacency_build, RAM_property_build, RAM_verify) + RAM_old_new_coexistence + RAM_runtime
preparation_model.freshness_model: Versioned immutable projection rebuilt or updated under an explicit freshness policy
amortization_assumptions: Projection build is reused across Q_amortized algorithms or runs
Mutation rate permits the selected freshness policy
preparation_model.shared_layout_baseline_comparison: This candidate is the shared-layout baseline against which specialization must report omitted and added bytes

correctness_and_determinism.exactness: Algorithm-specific exact or declared numerical contract
correctness_and_determinism.seed_policy: Caller-provided or receipt-recorded seed for randomized algorithms
correctness_and_determinism.ordering_guarantee: Only declared order is guaranteed; parallel accumulation order is recorded
correctness_and_determinism.oracle_strategy: Compare against the same Neo4j/GDS procedure fixture or a separately declared canonical oracle
correctness_and_determinism.refusal_rule: Refuse when requested semantics, determinism, projection, or state cannot fit the admitted budget

compatibility_boundary.neo4j: Property-graph input/output semantics and selected procedures; no store-format identity
compatibility_boundary.cypher: Only query patterns explicitly compiled to projection/catalog/algorithm operations
compatibility_boundary.bolt: Supported request, result, notification, and error framing only
compatibility_boundary.gds: Selected estimate/run procedure signatures with explicit unsupported catalog entries

crossover_guards.guard: Select resident projection only when all modeled bytes plus reserve fit B_user

composition_review.invariant_compatibility: A shared immutable projection can serve algorithms whose required directions and properties are all present
composition_review.memory_term_overlap: Projection bytes are shared across queries; algorithm and output state multiply per concurrent query
composition_review.prepared_artifact_coexistence: A replacement may require old and new projections simultaneously and is accounted explicitly
composition_review.access_pattern_conflicts: One adjacency ordering may be neutral or poor for some algorithms; the baseline accepts that compromise
composition_review.fallback_composition: Failure to fit does not silently spill; it lowers concurrency, invokes a declared reference, or refuses
composition_review.exactness_determinism_composition: Shared topology does not define algorithm exactness; each algorithm contract does
composition_review.preparation_rationality: Build is rational only when cross-algorithm reuse and freshness outweigh projection cost

estimator_feedback.calibration_action: Calibrate projection, algorithm-state, allocator, worker, and source-cache constants separately in G09
estimator_feedback.safety_action: Increase reserve, reduce concurrency, or refuse when calibrated upper error exceeds policy

loses_when: Projection plus state cannot fit B_user
A specialized artifact omits large unused topology or property terms
Concurrent per-query state dominates shared topology

smallest_g09_falsifier.fixture: One graph fixture reused by traversal, PageRank, WCC, and community procedures
smallest_g09_falsifier.baseline: Neo4j/GDS procedure and estimate on the same logical graph
smallest_g09_falsifier.oracle: Per-algorithm result digest, tolerance, seed, and ordering contract
smallest_g09_falsifier.modeled_expectation: The fully resident plan is admissible only when calibrated whole-process terms fit B_user
smallest_g09_falsifier.acceptance_thresholds: Reserved for G09; none asserted in G08
smallest_g09_falsifier.disconfirming_result: Unmodeled resident state, wrong result, unexplained nondeterminism, or an estimate that cannot bound observed RSS

candidates.name: Conservative Knight Bus Reference Baseline

generation_lineage.intended_changed_behavior: Preserve the current immutable dual-CSR and reference-algorithm path as a correctness and adoption baseline

target_workload_contract.artifact: current Knight Bus immutable snapshot with forward and reverse CSR and manifest
target_workload_contract.algorithm_semantics: Current supported reference semantics with explicit unsupported operations
target_workload_contract.a007_decision_strengthened: Provides the trusted fallback and oracle surface against which specialized capsules are verified

genome.topology_layout: Immutable forward and reverse CSR snapshot with manifest and stable IDs
genome.ordering_and_identifier_representation: Snapshot-local dense IDs with stable mapping and current ordering semantics
genome.algorithm_state_placement: Reference operation state allocated conservatively and accounted per query
genome.scheduling_and_concurrency: Conservative bounded workers and query admission; no speculative overlap
genome.overflow_behavior: Use current bounded build/runtime path where supported or refuse
genome.exactness: Current supported operation semantics are the oracle contract
genome.admission_model: Admit only supported operations whose conservative whole-process estimate fits B_user
genome.receipt_model: Extend current receipt seeds with observed high-water and estimator error once calibrated
genome.compatibility_boundary: Current narrow Bolt/Cypher/GDS surface only; unsupported entries fail before work

minimum_resident_kernel.admission_unit: current snapshot mappings plus minimum reference operation state
minimum_resident_kernel.refusal_condition: RAM_kernel > B_user or operation outside supported reference surface

resource_model.peak_ram_equation: RAM_peak = RAM_topology + RAM_algorithm_state + RAM_frontier_active_set + RAM_scratch + RAM_output + RAM_conversion + RAM_page_cache_or_direct_io + RAM_runtime_overhead + RAM_spill + RAM_safety_margin + RAM_temporary_artifact_coexistence

ram_terms.runtime_overhead: RAM_runtime_overhead = c_runtime + c_allocator * allocation_classes + c_thread * threads
ram_terms.temporary_artifact_coexistence: RAM_temporary_artifact_coexistence = RAM_old_snapshot_mapped + RAM_new_snapshot_build_or_map during epoch transition

resource_model.preprocessing: T_prepare = T_external_runs + T_merge + T_emit_forward + T_emit_reverse + T_verify
resource_model.storage: Storage_total = S_forward_csr + S_reverse_csr + S_id_maps + S_manifest + S_receipts
resource_model.concurrency: RAM_concurrency = Q * RAM_reference_query + W * RAM_worker_private + D_io * RAM_io_buffer

state_multiplicity.stages: max(RAM_build_stage_i, RAM_query_stage_j) plus explicit overlap when both coexist

page_cache_direct_io_policy.guard: Mapped bytes are not assumed resident or free; measured RSS and residency counters remain distinct receipt fields

preparation_model.build_io: IO_build = IO_input + IO_runs + IO_merge + IO_forward + IO_reverse + IO_verify
preparation_model.temporary_bytes: S_temporary_peak = S_old_snapshot + S_new_snapshot + S_runs + S_sort_workspace + S_journal
preparation_model.freshness_model: Immutable snapshot epochs with verified publish
amortization_assumptions: Snapshot is reused across supported operations
preparation_model.shared_layout_baseline_comparison: This is the conservative Knight Bus shared-layout and reference fallback baseline

correctness_and_determinism.ordering_guarantee: Current stable snapshot and result ordering contract where declared
nondeterministic_sources: filesystem completion order hidden by verified publication
correctness_and_determinism.oracle_strategy: Use current reference implementation and Neo4j fixture agreement where the compatibility scope overlaps
correctness_and_determinism.refusal_rule: Refuse unsupported semantics or budgets below the conservative minimum kernel

compatibility_boundary.neo4j: Supported logical graph and result semantics only
compatibility_boundary.bolt: Current implemented framing and stable unsupported errors
compatibility_boundary.gds: Current graph catalog/projection entries plus only explicitly implemented algorithms

crossover_guards.guard: Remain on reference layout whenever a specialized candidate lacks a calibrated advantage or matching oracle

composition_review.invariant_compatibility: The current immutable snapshot and reference operation define the fallback correctness invariant
composition_review.memory_term_overlap: Mapped topology, page cache, resident pages, and RSS are tracked without summing aliases blindly
composition_review.prepared_artifact_coexistence: Old and new snapshot epochs may coexist and are explicit build/publish terms
composition_review.access_pattern_conflicts: Dual CSR favors traversal reuse but may retain direction or ordering bytes unused by one algorithm
composition_review.fallback_composition: Specialized candidates may return to this baseline only when its own budget admission succeeds
composition_review.exactness_determinism_composition: Reference semantics become an oracle only for operations already supported and matched
composition_review.preparation_rationality: The shared snapshot is rational when multi-operation reuse exceeds dual-CSR and rebuild costs

estimator_feedback.calibration_action: Calibrate mapping residency, allocator, page cache, worker state, and output separately in G09
estimator_feedback.safety_action: Increase reserve, reduce concurrency, or refuse when prediction error violates the envelope

loses_when: Dual CSR or reference state exceeds B_user
One specialized capsule safely omits substantial shared-layout state
The requested Neo4j/GDS surface is broader than current support

smallest_g09_falsifier.fixture: The existing 2 GB Night Bus dependency/access-path dataset and supported query fixture
smallest_g09_falsifier.baseline: Current Knight Bus reference path and matching Neo4j query where available
smallest_g09_falsifier.oracle: Exact canonical result digest and stable error contract
smallest_g09_falsifier.modeled_expectation: The conservative model can reject before execution and explain observed high-water by named terms after calibration
smallest_g09_falsifier.acceptance_thresholds: Reserved for G09; none asserted in G08
smallest_g09_falsifier.disconfirming_result: Wrong result, unstable unsupported behavior, hidden build overlap, or peak RSS outside the calibrated conservative envelope
